definitions.explanation: A general term for plastic film, sheets, or bags. In everyday Japanese, used broadly for various types of plastic materials, not just true vinyl.

examples.japanese: ビニール{袋|ぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can I get a plastic bag?
I use a vinyl umbrella on rainy days.

examples.japanese: ⟦レジ{袋|ぶくろ}→レジ袋：09531_rejibukuro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有料|ゆうりょう}→有料：03178_yuuryou⟧になって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ビニール{袋|ぶくろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使用量|しようりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: Since shopping bags became paid, the use of plastic bags has decreased.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese, ビニール is used as a general term for plastic film and related products, even when the material is not technically vinyl (polyvinyl chloride). The word functions both as a standalone noun and as a modifier.
Since July 2020, Japan has required retailers to charge for ビニール{袋|ぶくろ} (plastic bags), leading many people to carry ⟦エコバッグ→エコバッグ：08937_ekobaggu⟧ (reusable bags) instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ビニール{袋|ぶくろ} (plastic bag)
- ビニール{傘|がさ} (vinyl umbrella — clear, disposable)
- ビニールハウス (vinyl greenhouse)
- ビニールシート (vinyl/plastic sheet)
- ビニール⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧ (vinyl/plastic gloves)

ETYMOLOGY:
From English "vinyl."
